verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a payments/commerce platform that exposes its own APIs as tools to AI agents (via its MCP server and agent toolkit) — it is not itself an agent or orchestrator that a user configures with external MCP servers to expand its own tool access. The story's premise (plugging MCP servers into the product so it can use their tools) is a category error for a commerce backend/tool-provider like this.
